r.notes: Our family has owned this 80 acre property since the 1970s and this is the first ever time we have seen a koala on our property!...  I never knew they were getting this close to Strathalbyn...  It was a large male.  We noticed it as it was making that unmistakable grunting noise.  It was near the top of a huge River Red. (20m or so up)
